A Rift-touched panther-like predator whose natural displacement ability has been amplified by Veil exposure — it now exists partially in both reality and the Veil simultaneously. Attacking a rift-displacer is like fighting a reflection in troubled water. They hunt in the twilight boundaries between the Hollows and settled lands.
## Traits
**Avoidance.** If subjected to an effect that allows a saving throw for half damage, it takes no damage on a success, half on a failure.
**Displacement.** The rift displacer projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attacks to have disadvantage. If hit, this trait is disrupted until end of its next turn. Not disrupted if the rift displacer is incapacitated or speed 0.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two tentacle attacks.
**Tentacle.** +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning + 3 (1d6) piercing.
